named_predicate.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:
  SRC: {path: input.csv}
  D: {path: donor.csv, types: {SEQ: int}}
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: D
    key: [ID]
    order_by: [D.SEQ]
    keep: first
    no_match: null
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, VALUE]}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - name: VALUE
    type: str
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "P.A = 'first'"
          then: {literal: yes}
        - otherwise: {literal: no}
